data.exact_reserve_text: The underwriting profit of GBP 6.0m in 2015 (2014, profit of GBP 7.0m) includes a release from prior year reserves of GBP 12.4m (2014, GBP 10.6m release).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross release on prior-year claims of approximately GBP 19.2m in 2015 (a reduction of about 6.24% of opening gross reserves of GBP 307.2m), driven by favourable development in older accident years (notably 2011 and 2012) partially offset by some adverse movement in 2013. The managing agent reports a net prior-year release of GBP 12.4m included in the underwriting result, implying reinsurance recoveries absorbed part of the gross release. No specific named catastrophe events are identified as drivers of the movement in the disclosed notes.
raw_causal_phrases: includes a release from prior year reserves of GBP 12.4m (2014, GBP 10.6m release).

Significant delays occur in notifying certain claims and a large measure of experience and judgement is involved in assessing outstanding liabilities, the ultimate cost of which cannot be known with certainty at the reporting date.

the impact of various factors such as trends in claim frequency and severity, changes in operations, emerging economic and social trends, inflation and changes in regulatory and litigation environments is considered.
Management currently believes the Syndicate's gross and net reserves are adequate.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) on page 29 because no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' figure was provided. The managing agent narrative reports a net prior-year release of GBP 12.4m (this is net of reinsurance); the gross triangle implies a larger gross release (~GBP 19.171m), the difference reflecting reinsurance. Premium mix contains negative gross written premium lines (adjustments/cancellations) as printed in the segmental table. No specific named catastrophe events were listed in the reserves note.
